# How Router Renders Components

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## How Router Renders Components

Imagine that our Journal App initially consists of three pages, each handled by a separate component:

| Page / Component | URL |
| --- | --- |
| HomePage | / |
| EntryDetailPage | /entries/:id |
| NotFoundPage | Any other URL |

The image below shows how Routes matches the URLs and renders the components:

![How React Router Works](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

If you type and enter / in the browser address bar, Routes will render HomePage. Entering /entries/:id will render EntryDetailPage, and so on.

Next, let's get a basic idea of how this works behind the scenes.
